name: cgp-files
description: An IDE-style file tree beside your Claude Code session: git status per file and folder, a search over the whole project, and rows that glow where Claude reads, writes and commits. By Crypto Gameplan.

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: What glows in the tree while Claude works: files it reads (Read, or rg, grep, find, cat in Bash) in violet, writes in CGP gold, git actions in green.

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads, writes or commits. off: the view stays where you put it; the glow still shows.

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: the pane opens when a session starts. off: it stays closed until you run /cgp-files.

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows at start: date (last modified) or size (files in bytes, folders as disk usage worked out in the background). The Σ button toggles it.

open.title: Open with
open.description: What a double-click or Enter does with a file. Empty: the default app. preview: show it in the pane. Anything else is a command run instead: {path} is the file, {dir} its folder, and without {path} the path goes last. Quotes keep a word whole; no shell runs it.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto: Nerd Font icons when one is installed, plain Unicode in the desktop app. nerd or plain forces one.
